recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Revisit only if FHIR-I later decides to make chained identifier and :identifier searches equivalent or changes server capability expectations.
issue_request: FHIR-29410 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked to remove the :identifier modifier or make it equivalent to chained identifier searches; FHIR-I rejected equivalence but approved adding explanatory text about the difference and possible need for clients to account for both.

additional_context: FHIR-37424 is the same change family and was resolved by pointing to FHIR-29410. Later FHIR-45252 refined adjacent chaining/modifier wording for non-Reference references, but it did not make :identifier equivalent to chained identifier searches and was already represented on the combined branch.
